panels.title: Service health — independent of campaign instrumentation
Updater Redis-acknowledged records / second
panels.description: Acknowledged access records, not unique objects. Delivery retries can count duplicates.

panels.title: Seconds since last completed full traversal
panels.description: Absent before the first successful scan; initial scan grace has a separate alert. This is not traversal duration or cursor age.

panels.title: Redis used / configured maximum memory
panels.description: No ratio when maxmemory=0 (unlimited). Allow memory headroom for AOF/RDB fork and buffers.

panels.title: Campaign metrics — continuous private HTTP monitor

options.content: Select a run and one monitor endpoint; multiple endpoints can expose the same aggregate run, so their inventories and traffic must not be summed. Traffic/latency rates need at least two samples; the error ratio requires a complete recorded 5m window. Read cumulative errors even while rates warm up or traffic is idle. Full-body GET histograms include failed attempts; absent/idle histograms yield no latency estimate. Verified GET bytes exclude failed validation and do not measure PUT upload throughput. Expected-negative probes are excluded from request/error panels. Cohort/gate gauges describe current seed versions, not cumulative transition events. There is no lifecycle latency histogram. Use observation age to judge metadata freshness and the existing Loki datasource for detailed logs.

panels.title: Campaign request rate
panels.description: Measured S3 attempts per second by stage and operation, excluding deliberate expected-negative probes. This is closed-loop achieved load, not configured offered RPS.

panels.title: Successful verified GET throughput
panels.description: Payload bytes per second returned only after full-body length/checksum and version validation. Failed reads contribute zero bytes; this metric does not account for PUT upload bytes or wire overhead.

panels.title: Campaign error rate
panels.description: Observed five-minute error/request ratio from stable per-stage recording counters. Requires a boundary sample and a complete 5m history at 15s evaluation. Warming, gaps, absent requests and idle windows are no data, not zero. A zero ratio covers only this observed interval; cumulative errors above retain earlier failures. The first snapshot cannot reconstruct pre-scrape error timing.

panels.title: Full-body GET latency p95 / p99
panels.description: Histogram estimates for get_object attempts, including body consumption and verification on successful reads, and elapsed time for failed attempts. Finite producer buckets end at 60s. No estimate is displayed without observed GETs; lifecycle/restore completion latency is not instrumented.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage) (rate(cwm_objstore_loadtest_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="objstore-campaign",cluster="$cluster",tenant="$tenant",run_id="$run_id",instance="$campaign_instance",operation="get_object"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (stage) (sum by (stage) (rate(cwm_objstore_loadtest_request_duration_seconds_count{job="objstore-campaign",cluster="$cluster",tenant="$tenant",run_id="$run_id",instance="$campaign_instance",operation="get_object"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, stage) (rate(cwm_objstore_loadtest_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="objstore-campaign",cluster="$cluster",tenant="$tenant",run_id="$run_id",instance="$campaign_instance",operation="get_object"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (stage) (sum by (stage) (rate(cwm_objstore_loadtest_request_duration_seconds_count{job="objstore-campaign",cluster="$cluster",tenant="$tenant",run_id="$run_id",instance="$campaign_instance",operation="get_object"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Campaign stage status
panels.description: One-hot status gauges: passed, failed, aborted, inconclusive or running. Missing stages have not produced status evidence.

panels.title: Observed cohort state
panels.description: Counts of current seed versions by bounded cohort/state, including missing, unknown and invalid observations. These are latest observations, not live storage inventory or repeated scanner counters.

panels.title: Last cohort observation age
panels.description: Age of the newest valid current-version metadata observation in each cohort, not the oldest object's age and not monitor refresh age. Zero timestamps (no observation) are omitted.

panels.title: Lifecycle completed objects by gate
panels.description: Gauge of current seed objects with version-matched passed gate proofs (cold, heat, restore, renewal, expiry). Not a cumulative event counter or a latency measurement.

panels.title: Observed restore expiry bounds
panels.description: Earliest/latest known restore deadlines by cohort (bound=min|max), not proof of actual re-tiering. Zero/unknown deadlines are omitted. Seconds are converted to milliseconds only for Grafana's date display.

panels.title: Campaign observed errors (cumulative)
panels.description: Observed cumulative non-probe errors in the selected run/stage, visible from the very first positive snapshot. Expected-negative probes are excluded, as in the request/error ratio. No errors series is zero only when request evidence exists; no request/error evidence is no data. Counts are not error occurrence timestamps and do not disappear when traffic stops or rate history warms.

targets.expr: sum by (stage) (cwm_objstore_loadtest_errors_total{job="objstore-campaign",cluster="$cluster",tenant="$tenant",run_id="$run_id",instance="$campaign_instance",operation!~".*[.]expected-negative"}) or on (stage) (0 * sum by (stage) (cwm_objstore_loadtest_requests_total{job="objstore-campaign",cluster="$cluster",tenant="$tenant",run_id="$run_id",instance="$campaign_instance",operation!~".*[.]expected-negative"}))

panels.title: Campaign error-rate history
panels.description: Rate availability, not health: warming/incomplete means the fixed five-minute observation window is not yet available; idle means no observed request increments. No result means history is unavailable (no current request evidence or recording rules not producing it). Read cumulative errors independently of this status.
